blocks.content: Compilers, headers, and dev dependencies are needed to build and useless at runtime. A second stage copies out only the artifact and leaves the toolchain behind.

FROM golang:1.25 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /bin/api ./cmd/api

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static
COPY --from=build /bin/api /api
ENTRYPOINT ["/api"]

items: Smaller images pull faster and start faster
No shell and no package manager means a far smaller attack surface
